name: Dead Souls II
english_description: The real, self-identified 'Dead Souls Mud Library II,' released as public domain by Cratylus in November 2006 -- a distinct middle generation of the Dead Souls object library, between the earlier Nightmare-IV-era snapshot and the later, much larger 3.8.6 generation. A brand-new install walks the very first connecting player through a genuine first-boot admin-setup wizard (name, password, gender, display name, email, real name, and a race pick from seven options: halfling, elf, orc, half-orc, human, half-elf, or dwarf) before the mud restarts into its normal, ongoing registration flow. Four domains ship with the archive: a small default starting area, a town, an example town called Ylsrim with a pub, an armoury, a weaponsmith, a jar-and-lightning-bug minigame object, and a couple of deliberately 'broken' disease-item teaching examples, plus an LPC-University-themed campus area complete with a live greeter-bot NPC. The mud preloads a real Intermud-3 client and makes a genuine outbound connection to a live I3 nameserver a few seconds after every boot.
